findings.reason: a node implementing §3 as written cannot call the named helper from the caller the plan names and must invent the parameter shape (add repo_dir/docs_dir to derived_plan_age or resolve them internally), so the plan under-specifies the one interface the change turns on.
findings.text: §3 routes the commit read "through the existing last-commit lookup _git_last_committed (reckon/serve.py:1432)", but that function's signature is _git_last_committed(repo_dir: Path, docs_dir: Path) and it returns a whole-docs-dir mapping keyed by repo-relative path, while derived_plan_age takes a single fallback_path and §3 says only that "the roadmap's first call (reckon/roadmap.py:945) … passes the plan's path" — a plan path supplies neither repo_dir nor docs_dir

findings.reason: the mechanism (author date) and the measure (committer date) disagree on which git date is the age source, so the graded test cannot succeed until the fixture sets GIT_AUTHOR_DATE too or the reader selects %ct.
findings.text: the done-when backdates the fixture commit "by GIT_COMMITTER_DATE" only, but _git_last_committed sources its timestamp from git log "--format=COMMIT %at" (author date, reckon/serve.py:1455), so a commit whose committer date is 20 days old but whose author date is now reads as age 0 and produces no AGING row, and the test cannot pass as written
